I am reading three files before I draft the flowchart:

- The current skill, to find where the purge-or-expire choice sits.
- The baseline reasons, to see which questions the agents got wrong.
- The graphviz style rules.

The diamonds in the chart must ask the questions the agents skipped. The 11 wrong purges show what those questions are. I will not invent the criteria. If the skill and the baseline do not define a condition, I will ask you to define it.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- A flowchart suits this failure. The agents make a choice between two options and pick the wrong one. writing-skills allows a flowchart for "when to use A vs B" decisions.
- Each diamond must test something the agent can observe in the task, such as "can stale data cause wrong behavior?" A vague prompt like "is purging needed?" gives the agent room to keep its old habit.
- This edit is the GREEN step. It is not done until the same three scenarios pass with the new chart.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

After the edit, I will run the same three scenarios again, with 5 reps each. Then I will compare the results with the 11 of 15 wrong purges in the baseline. If agents still purge keys that should expire, I will tighten the decision nodes and test again. I will report the counts to you either way.
